description:
**NOTICE**
The Cobalt Lake Trail and the 5040 Hut, managed by the Alpine Club of Canada, will be closed September 1 to October 3 to allow for a bridge upgrade on the access road.

Please respect all posted closures and avoid entering the area during this time.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Non motorized hiking trail. The trail goes up to Cobalt Lake at 1151 meters, further up to the hut at 1318 meters and onto the peak at 1521 meters. From the peak is amazing view of the surrounding mountains and the pacific ocean on a clear day. The top area has a rocky basin with much to explore. To the north is Nahmint Mountain at 1563 meter.

Hut reservations are through the Alpine Club of Canada - Vancouver Island Section: https://accvi.ca/5040-peak-hut/bookthehut/
title: Cobalt Lake Trail
